question.text: An importer buys 50 lots of USDINR 84 call at Rs. 0.15 premium. Total premium outflow is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 82 of the source states that the exchange-traded currency option lot size is 1000 USD and that the maximum loss per lot equals lot size times premium. So total premium = 0.15 x 1000 x 50 = Rs. 7,500. The Trap: Forgetting the lot-size multiplier of 1000 collapses the answer to Rs. 750 or Rs. 150; multiplying twice inflates it to Rs. 75,000. Note: Page 119 supports the use case — an importer buying USDINR calls hedges its future dollar payable against USD appreciation.
